edges.reason: msg.sender is returned verbatim by _msgSender() as the caller identity

onlyOwner reads owner() to authorize the caller

_setOwner writes the new value into the _owner state variable
newOwner parameter flows into the transferOwnership body
newOwner parameter is forwarded from transferOwnership into _setOwner
oldOwner local reads the previous _owner value before overwrite
newOwner parameter of _setOwner is assigned into _owner

impl parameter is validated and consumed by replaceImplementation

account parameter is used in the extcodesize check
size local holds the extcodesize result compared against zero
impl parameter value is written into the implementation state variable
onlyOwner guarded function mutates the implementation delegate target

normalization_plan.reason: oldOwner is a transient local only used to emit the event inside _setOwner, so it collapses into that function node
size only holds the extcodesize result returned by isContract and has no independent semantics
account is the sole input of isContract and is fully captured by the function node
recipient is the transfer destination of sendValue and collapses into the function node
amount is the value forwarded by sendValue and collapses into the function node
target is the call destination consumed by the functionCall wrapper and has no separate behaviour
data is the raw payload consumed by the functionCall wrapper and has no separate behaviour
newOwner is the entry argument of transferOwnership and is fully accounted for by that function node
newOwner is the writing argument of _setOwner and collapses into that internal function node
impl is the validated upgrade address of replaceImplementation and merges into that access-controlled function
the local impl loaded from storage exists only to feed the delegatecall unsafe operation in fallback
